## Contexto de sesión

Crea estos objetos en tu espacio de trabajo, pregunta cómo unirlos para mantener todas las filas de `df1` y las filas coincidentes de `df2`

```{r}
#| echo: true
#| eval: false
library(tibble)
df1 <- tibble(id = 1:5)
df2 <- tibble(identifier = c(1, 1, 2),
 y = c("first", "second", "third"))
```

# Extracción de datos estructurados

## Múltiples entradas a objetos R utilizables

### 🐘 `ellmer`

-   Crear objeto chat
-   Definir esquema usando un objeto 'type'
-   Ejecutar `chat_structured`

## Información biográfica

-   Crear cadena de texto con información biográfica

-   Definir esquema deseado usando `type_object`

-   Usar método `chat_structured`

## 

```{r}
#| eval: true
#| echo: true

library(ellmer)
chatbio <- chat_openrouter(model = "~z-ai/glm-flash-latest", system_prompt = "extrae información")

bio_text <- "Gonzalo Pineda Reyes (born October 19, 1982) is a Mexican professional football manager and former player. Pineda played as a defensive midfielder for several clubs in Mexico, and also represented Mexico internationally. He last played in 2015 for the Seattle Sounders FC. He became assistant coach of the Sounders beginning with the 2017 season. "

bio_type <- type_object(
  name=type_string("First initial and last name"),
  sport=type_string("Sport played and professional leagues, separate with colon"),
  ctry=type_string("Country of origin")
)

```

## 

```{r}
#| eval: true
#| echo: true
chatbio$chat_structured(type=bio_type,bio_text)
```

## Visión 🔭

::::: columns
::: {.column width="50%"}
![](https://www.surfdogchampionships.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/08/i-Wg3VMHr-L.jpg){width="53%"}
:::

::: {.column width="50%"}
Las imágenes también se pueden tokenizar. Las preparamos con funciones `content_image_*`.
:::
:::::

```{r}
#| echo: true
#| eval: true
#| output-location: slide

chatImg <- chat_openrouter(model = "~z-ai/glm-flash-latest")
chatImg$chat(
  content_image_url("https://www.surfdogchampionships.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/08/i-Wg3VMHr-L.jpg"),
  "Qué hay en esta foto? contesta con brevedad y solo en mayúsculas"
)
```
